# action.docker_compose_exec

<!-- Code generated by tools/genskill from the provider schema. DO NOT EDIT. -->

Kind: action. Back to [SKILL.md](../SKILL.md).

Runs a command in a running container of a compose service, like `docker compose exec`, and fails when it exits non-zero. The container is found by the `com.docker.compose.*` labels. The result carries `exit_code` and the captured `stdout` / `stderr`.

Actions need Terraform >= 1.14. They keep no state: they run when a
resource's `lifecycle { action_trigger { ... } }` fires, or on demand with
`terraform apply -invoke=action.docker_compose_exec.<name>`. Arguments go inside
the action's `config` block.

## Usage

```terraform
action "docker_compose_exec" "<name>" {
  config {
    # arguments below
  }
}

# Run it: lifecycle { action_trigger { events = [after_create] actions = [action.docker_compose_exec.<name>] } }
# on a resource, or: terraform apply -invoke=action.docker_compose_exec.<name>
```

## Arguments and attributes

| Name | Type | Status | Forces replacement | Sensitive | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `command` | `list(string)` | required |  |  | Command and arguments, exec form. No shell is added. |
| `environment` | `map(string)` | optional |  |  | Extra environment variables (CLI `-e`). |
| `index` | `number` | optional |  |  | Which container of the service, by container number (CLI `--index`). Default `1`. |
| `name` | `string` | required |  |  | The compose project name (`com.docker.compose.project` label, CLI `--project-name`). |
| `privileged` | `bool` | optional |  |  | Extended privileges (CLI `--privileged`). Default `false`. |
| `result_path` | `string` | optional |  |  | Local file the action writes its result object to after a successful run. The file holds one JSON object keyed by the action's output names (`result`, the identity values, the raw outputs with their `*_sha256` hashes, and the version values), with keys sorted at every level, two-space indentation and a trailing newline; it is written atomically (temporary file, then rename) and parent directories are created. Read it in a later run with `jsondecode(file(...))` or the `local_file` data source. Sensitive values are written in full, since this is your own file, but show as `(sensitive)` in the progress message. Nothing is written when the action fails. |
| `service` | `string` | required |  |  | The service whose container runs the command. |
| `timeout` | `string` | optional |  |  | How long the command may take, as a Go duration (`30s`, `10m`). Default `10m`. |
| `user` | `string` | optional |  |  | User to run as (CLI `--user`). |
| `workdir` | `string` | optional |  |  | Working directory (CLI `--workdir`). |

## Example

```terraform
resource "docker_compose" "shop" {
  name    = "shop"
  content = <<-EOT
    services:
      web:
        image: nginx:1.27-alpine
        ports: ["8080:80"]
      worker:
        image: busybox:1.36
        command: ["sh", "-c", "sleep 3600"]
  EOT

  lifecycle {
    action_trigger {
      events  = [after_create, after_update]
      actions = [action.docker_compose_exec.this]
    }
  }
}

# Checks the nginx configuration inside shop-web-1. On demand:
#   terraform apply -invoke=action.docker_compose_exec.this
action "docker_compose_exec" "this" {
  config {
    name        = docker_compose.shop.name
    service     = "web"
    command     = ["nginx", "-t"]
    result_path = "${path.module}/exec-result.json"
  }
}
```
